data.text: Multiplayer AI needs to move past the group chat phase. Chats are chaotic, everyone sees everything (creating social & management issues), and they're bad for long projects. Worse, they keep AI trapped inside existing teams, when its real promise is working & helping across them.

urls.description: Background: The Choosing Wisely initiative made recommendations where screening, testing, or treatment may be overused, with caveats around appropriate use. Clinicians are increasingly using large language models (LLMs). Objective: To evaluate whether commercial LLMs appropriately call for restraint or action from scenarios based on Choosing Wisely recommendations. Design: Benchmark evaluation. Fifteen Choosing Wisely recommendations were used to develop 225 scenarios (per recommendation, 10 in which restraint was appropriate and 5 in which action was appropriate). Six commercial LLMs (3 runs each) generated 4050 responses to the 225 scenarios, using a prompt from the clinician perspective. Setting: Production application programming interfaces of OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google from February to March 2026. Participants: No human participants were involved. Measurements: Co-primary outcomes were the overuse rate (endorsing action when restraint was appropriate) and the false restraint ra
urls.title: Overuse and False Restraint in Large Language Model Recommendations for Choosing Wisely Scenarios | Annals of Internal Medicine
